checkpointPayload.description: From the ui-ux-pro-max review (2026-10-30), item 5: no screen uses react-native-safe-area-context (it's installed). The ManualCreditModal header guesses the notch with paddingTop Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 54 : 20 (components/ManualCreditModal.tsx ~l.915), which is wrong on Dynamic Island and taller-notch phones and on Android edge-to-edge. Use useSafeAreaInsets() for the modal header and any fixed bottom CTA, and check app/modal.tsx and the scroll content bottom insets.
checkpointPayload.title: Mobile: use real safe-area insets
